title: 灾后写作
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Generate ONE 16:9 live-action narrative film frame, not an illustration. The attached image provides the exact young man's identity, hair, worn civilian clothes, window construction and room materials. This is the NEXT MORNING after that storm, same humble Caribbean room, photographed from a NEW camera position beside his LEFT shoulder, looking down obliquely across his right arm toward a small dry corner of the same rough working table. No collage or split screen.
Same clean-shaven young man, slender long youthful face, olive skin, brown eyes, loosely low-tied dark wavy hair. Same faded charcoal-brown waistcoat with back adjustment strap, dirty unbleached linen shirt with sleeves rolled below elbows and brown knee breeches, now damp rather than soaking. Keep hair clumped from humidity and unevenly rumpled, no beauty styling. Camera slightly behind his left shoulder at seated chest height, about 50mm natural perspective. The left edge crops some of the back of his shoulder. The face is visible only as a tired partial side view in ambient shade; his attention is on paper, not the audience.
His RIGHT hand holds one simple quill with nib just 1cm ABOVE a single gray-white rag paper on the dry table; his LEFT hand rests lightly on the lower edge of the paper. Both hands visibly belong to him. Paper has only one or two tiny low-contrast ink marks and is mostly blank, not already full of writing, no legible text. A squat dark ceramic inkpot sits beyond the top edge of the paper out of the path of his forearm. Paper, inkpot and hands are all visible with ordinary useful depth of field, no fetishized macro shot.
In the middle distance at left the recognizable two-leaf wooden shutter from reference has ONE loosened board and a damaged latch after the storm; nearby wall and floor remain wet, a thin patch of daylight reaches the wet floor. Keep the table's writing corner visibly dry and away from drips; no flying papers, no candle. Small living-room shelf and cookware remain useful in dim rear space. Restrained humid daylight, brighter exterior, no separate key light on his face. Natural dirty whites, weathered gray wood and faint wet green foliage; no sepia wash or glamour color grade.
It must feel like an unpolished captured moment in a used room, a person about to write after a long morning. No oil painting, no staged period portrait, no theatrical tableau, no heroic gaze, no gold dust, no glossy skin, no full-room symmetrical furniture arrangement, no overly picturesque ruins, no modern objects, borders, captions, readable writing, or watermarks.
note: 原始图片生成请求记录。视频动作以 prompts/ 中经实际首帧核对后的最终提示词为准。
